description:
In routing.rs, add_newsgroups_header and synthesize_message_id check for CRLF ('
') in the constructed value before injecting it as a header. However, RFC 5322 §2.2 treats a bare LF as a header folding separator in some implementations. A value containing '
' without '' could split the header line in MUA renderers that accept bare-LF line endings. Fix: reject values containing either '' or '
' (not just the CRLF sequence) in the header injection guard.
title: smtp: routing.rs header injection check only tests for CRLF, not bare LF
